evidence_boundary.evidence_nature: original participant-authored visual identity specification with recomputable accessibility gates; all geometry, colors and rules are declared here and verified by visual/assets/brand-identity-audit.js
allowed_claims: The identity system is original, drawn from the proposal's own railway-ticket metaphor, and contains no third-party logos, fonts, images or trademarks.
Declared color pairs, state tokens, lockups and application anchors pass the recomputable E2 gates executed by the audit script.
The system is a reference for professional teams and reviewers, ready for critique and deepening.
prohibited_claims: Do not claim trademark registration, trademark clearance, legal availability of the mark, or freedom-to-use opinions.
Do not claim brand recognition, usability, legibility or international-audience effectiveness observed with real users.
Do not claim the identity is an official, approved, adopted or implemented identifier of the Jing-Zhang corridor, Haidian district, or any organizer.
Do not present event templates as scheduled real events, partnerships, funding or operational commitments.

name_and_lockup_text.tagline_zh: 两条正线，一张会到期的票
name_and_lockup_text.tagline_en: Two lines, one ticket that expires
name_and_lockup_text.naming_note_zh: 名称与联排文字沿用本投稿既有命名，不新创名称；本轮只补视觉识别系统本身。

logo_mark.concept_zh: 把「共」字写成两条不闭合的轨线：两条水平线分别代表数据参与正线与无数据等价正线，两笔竖道与下端八字开口代表共同但有边界的相遇，右侧七孔撕线代表每个人可以撕下并保留的回执。
logo_mark.concept_en: The character 共 (together) is drawn as two open rail lines: two horizontal strokes for the data-participation and no-data-equivalent lines, two vertical sleepers plus a splayed base for bounded encounter, and seven perforation holes on the right for the receipt everyone may tear off and keep.
logo_mark.non_closure_rule_zh: 两条轨线的端点不与任何元素连接，图形永不闭合为矩形框；闭合版本视为误用。

mono_variant.rule_zh: 单色、反白与触觉版本只使用 ink 或 paper 一色；两条正线在单色版本中仍通过实线与虚线区分，不依赖颜色。
mono_variant.tactile_guidance_zh: 触觉或凸线印刷时最小线宽 0.4 mm，最小整体高度 8 mm；该值为制作建议，未经过触觉用户测试。

forbidden_pair_examples.reason_zh: 对比度约 1.36，任何文字或图形角色均不可用
forbidden_pair_examples.reason_en: Contrast about 1.36; never allowed for text or graphics

palette.contrast_formula: WCAG 2.x relative luminance on sRGB channels (c/12.92 below 0.03928, else ((c+0.055)/1.055)^2.4; L = 0.2126R + 0.7152G + 0.0722B); contrast = (L1 + 0.05) / (L2 + 0.05). Thresholds 4.5 for text and 3.0 for graphics follow WCAG 2.1 AA as engineering gates; the formula is recomputed by the audit, not transcribed by hand.

typography.offline_rule_zh: 正文与标识优先使用操作系统自带字体栈，不下载、不引用任何网络字体；唯一的例外是为无障碍可读性而内嵌的 OFL 授权 Noto Sans SC 子集（local() 优先，缺失时回退包内嵌子集样式表），见 visual/assets/fonts-noto-subset.css 与 sources.json 的 FONT-NOTO-SANS-SC 记录。

embedded_accessibility_fallback.reason: P3-02 review response: keep Chinese readable in font-deprived environments
embedded_accessibility_fallback.subset_scope: glyphs used by this package's bilingual HTML carriers only, embedded as base64 data-URIs (the validator allows no font file extensions)

typography.lockup_capitalization_en: ALL CAPS with letter-spacing 0.12em for THE DATA CO-OP LINE

lockups.text: 共数京张 / THE DATA CO-OP LINE

applications.note_zh: 灯塔光带使用四态 token（颜色+形状+文字），永不显示个人或商业数据。

applications.name_zh: 第一张回执亭票面框架
applications.note_zh: 票夹与撕线母题承载到期/撤回流程说明，不承诺从既有模型彻底抹除影响。

applications.name_zh: 共同作者广场荣誉标识
applications.note_zh: 荣誉基于可核验贡献与自愿署名；拒绝公开者可匿名或不出现。

applications.name_zh: 无数据等价服务站导视
applications.note_zh: 两条正线用实线/虚线+文字区分，不依赖颜色；导视只显示流程与方向。
票面以标识、撕线与回执联呈现用途、期限、停止与撤回回执；字段以协议 JSON 为准。

applications.name_zh: 共数开放周活动品牌模板
applications.name_en: Data Co-op Open Week event brand template
applications.note_zh: 年度活动品牌的中英海报与导视模板；不代表已有主办方、档期、经费或国际合作。

applications.name_zh: 国际传播双语一页纸模板
applications.note_zh: 英文优先联排与反向色规范；未经过国际受众测试。

misuse_rules.rule_zh: 不得拉伸、旋转、倾斜或改变笔画比例与撕线位置。
misuse_rules.rule_en: Do not stretch, rotate, skew, or change stroke ratios or the perforation position.

misuse_rules.rule_zh: 不得使用登记色板之外的颜色，不得交换两条正线的颜色。
misuse_rules.rule_en: Do not use colors outside the registered palette or swap the two line colors.

misuse_rules.rule_zh: 不得加入第三方商标、官方徽标、未授权字体或图片。
misuse_rules.rule_en: Do not add third-party trademarks, official emblems, or unlicensed fonts or images.

misuse_rules.rule_zh: 导视与地面系统不得展示参与者身份、贡献量排名或企业广告。
misuse_rules.rule_en: Wayfinding and ground systems must not show contributor identities, contribution rankings, or advertising.

misuse_rules.rule_zh: 不得把标识用于暗示政府批准、官方采用、获奖或已实施的场合。
misuse_rules.rule_en: Do not use the identity to imply government approval, official adoption, awards, or implementation.

misuse_rules.rule_zh: 不得以纯颜色区分两条正线或四种状态；必须同时给出形状/线型与文字。
misuse_rules.rule_en: Never distinguish the two lines or four states by color alone; always pair shape or dash with text.

accessibility_gates.reduced_motion: identity defines no motion; any animated application must honor prefers-reduced-motion
accessibility_gates.screen_reader: every rendered use of the mark carries bilingual alt text naming the two open lines and the tear-off receipt

replacement_triggers: 官方或主办方发布正式视觉识别要求时，本系统让位并仅保留历史版本记录。
取得授权的品牌/商标法律检索或专业品牌评审后，按结论修订并重新审计。
获得真实用户测试（含无障碍与国际受众）结果后，按观测证据修订。

negative_fixtures.mutation: raise pair-ink-paper required_min_contrast above its computed value
remove label_en from a state token
